description:
1. The agent must invoke /workspace/tools/create-agent.sh with the correct positional arguments: agent_name (lowercase+hyphens, e.g. 'pipeline-watcher'), a role description, a comma-separated duties list, a comma-separated skills list (etl-monitor, alert-router, pipeline-health, data-quality-check, slack-notifier), and the run-rules string.
2. The script creates ~/.openclaw/workspace/agents/{agent_name}/ containing SOUL.md, README.md, and a skills/ subdirectory.
3. SOUL.md must have a valid YAML front-matter block (---) with 'name', 'description', and 'created_at' fields — the proprietary trap that generic agents won't know.
4. SOUL.md must contain all four Chinese-language section headers exactly as specified in the SKILL.md: '## 职责', '## 可用 Skill', '## 运行规则', '## 使用示例' — another proprietary trap.
5. The '## 使用示例' section must contain '@{agent_name} [你的指令]' — the exact proprietary usage line format.
6. The skills/ subdirectory must contain symlinks pointing to the real skill directories under ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/ (not file copies).
7. README.md must exist and reference the agent name.
